title: 收益率不高：外资为何，买中国债？
speaker: Yifan Hu

segments.en: I think for China side now currently I think the boundary is indeed not high because China's inflation is still quite muted.
segments.zh: 我认为目前中国债券收益率确实不高，因为通胀仍然较低。

segments.en: We also don't think the like to support the market. We don't think the central government will actually cut the interest rates because it's already like a very low.
segments.zh: 我们也不认为央行会真正降息，因为利率已经很低了。

segments.en: But I think we already mentioned it's possible like for the PBOC to maybe cut the R rates and support the credit facility. So we think as a whole, the China will still keep its liquidity facility but will not cut rates.
segments.zh: 但我们已经提到，央行可能会下调准备金率以支持信贷。总体来看，中国将保持流动性宽松，但不会降息。

segments.en: But for China's CGB, I think another thing we should not forget because of the CNY appreciation. So this year, although the China's like a CGB rate is not high, but still attract, we see the international investors on the CGB and also policy backs.
segments.zh: 对于中国国债，我们还不能忽视人民币升值的影响。今年尽管国债收益率不高，但仍吸引了国际投资者，并且有政策支持。
